# 10-Day Madrid to Lisbon Low-Stress Trip Plan

A relaxed, museum-friendly itinerary with **one hotel base in Lisbon** and **one day trip**. I’m assuming you want a comfortable mid-budget trip for **2 adults**, with the **Madrid → Lisbon** transit included in the total.

## Day-by-Day Lisbon Base Itinerary

### Day 1: Fri, Apr 10 — Travel to Lisbon + Easy Evening
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/airplane.svg
- Morning: Fly or take the fastest practical transport from Madrid to Lisbon; keep the arrival day light.
- Afternoon: Check in, rest, then do a short walk in **Baixa** and **Chiado**.
- Food: Simple dinner near Rossio or Praça do Comércio; choose a casual tascas-style spot.

### Day 2: Sat, Apr 11 — Baixa, Alfama, and the River
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/geo-alt.svg
- Morning: Explore **Baixa** and **Rossio** on foot.
- Afternoon: Wander **Alfama** slowly; stop at viewpoints and small churches.
- Food: Try grilled fish or bifana sandwiches in a low-key neighborhood café.

### Day 3: Sun, Apr 12 — Museum Day
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/book.svg
- Morning: Visit one major museum, such as the **Calouste Gulbenkian Museum** or **Museu Nacional do Azulejo**.
- Afternoon: Add a second smaller museum or a relaxed café break.
- Food: Lunch near the museum area; keep it simple and unhurried.

### Day 4: Mon, Apr 13 — Belém Day
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/building.svg
- Morning: Head to **Belém** for **Jerónimos Monastery** and the riverside area.
- Afternoon: Visit **MAAT** or the **National Coach Museum**, depending on energy and interest.
- Food: Have a pastel de nata stop in Belém, then a light dinner back in the center.

### Day 5: Tue, Apr 14 — Walkable Neighborhoods + Free Time
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/map.svg
- Morning: Slow walk through **Príncipe Real** and **Bairro Alto**.
- Afternoon: Browse bookshops, gardens, or small galleries; keep this as a flexible recovery day.
- Food: Casual lunch and an early dinner to stay within budget.

### Day 6: Wed, Apr 15 — Day Trip to Sintra
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/tree.svg
- Morning: Take an early train to **Sintra**.
- Afternoon: Visit **Pena Palace** or choose one main site plus a scenic walk to avoid rushing.
- Food: Picnic-style lunch or a simple café meal in Sintra; return to Lisbon by evening.

### Day 7: Thu, Apr 16 — Modern Lisbon + Waterfront
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/water.svg
- Morning: Explore **Parque das Nações** or another modern riverside area.
- Afternoon: Relax with a waterfront walk and optional museum stop.
- Food: Budget-friendly dinner near your hotel or a neighborhood spot in central Lisbon.

### Day 8: Fri, Apr 17 — Slow Culture Day
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/calendar.svg
- Morning: Choose one cultural anchor you missed earlier, or revisit your favorite area.
- Afternoon: Café time, souvenir browsing, and a final scenic walk.
- Food: Keep meals straightforward; this is a good day to save money.

### Day 9: Sat, Apr 18 — Flexible Buffer Day
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/clock.svg
- Morning: Sleep in and do a late start.
- Afternoon: Use this as a backup for weather, fatigue, or a second museum.
- Food: One nicer dinner if the budget is still on track.

### Day 10: Sun, Apr 19 — Departure Day
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/house.svg
- Morning: Short breakfast and check-out.
- Afternoon: Head to the airport with plenty of time.
- Food: Light meal before departure; avoid committing to a long lunch.

## Estimated Budget for 2 Adults

| Category | Estimated Total | Notes |
|---|---:|---|
| Transport | EUR 220 | Madrid → Lisbon travel plus local transit |
| Lodging | EUR 900 | 9 nights in one mid-budget Lisbon hotel/apartment |
| Food | EUR 430 | Mix of casual lunches, simple dinners, café breakfasts |
| Attractions | EUR 210 | Museums, Belém sites, Sintra day trip entry/transport |
| Buffer | EUR 40 | Small cushion for transit or price changes |
| **Total** | **EUR 1,800** | Fits your target budget |

## Best-Fit Cost Plan

- **Transport:** Keep the intercity leg to the cheapest comfortable option available, then use transit/walking inside Lisbon.
- **Lodging:** Stay in **one central area** such as Baixa, Chiado, or Avenida da Liberdade to reduce transfers and taxi use.
- **Food:** Aim for breakfast at the lodging, lunch at casual cafés, and dinner at neighborhood restaurants.
- **Attractions:** Limit paid entries to **1 major museum every other day** and **one focused Sintra day trip**.

## Quick Actions

Action: [Button: Check trains/flights] https://www.rome2rio.com/s/Madrid/Lisbon
Action: [Button: Lisbon museum guide] https://www.visitlisboa.com/en/places-to-visit/museums
Action: [Button: Sintra day trip info] https://www.visitlisboa.com/en/places/sintra

## Sources

- Lisboa tourism: https://www.visitlisboa.com/en
- Sintra tourism: https://www.visitlisboa.com/en/places/sintra
- Madrid to Lisbon route options: https://www.rome2rio.com/s/Madrid/Lisbon
